verdict.rationale: Missive documents a REST API with an endpoint reference, Markdown versions of its doc pages and an llms.txt index, but the evidence states no OpenAPI spec is documented. Probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. Markdown prose docs are an adjacent convenience, not a downloadable machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
